name: AMOL PAWAR
player_statement:
A complete player, AMOL PAWAR has made a big mark in cricket. With 131 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 61, with an average of 17.51 and a quick strike rate of 134.96. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 88 sixes and 160 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 266.5 overs, taking 139 wickets at an economy rate of 7.54. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
